name: control-plane
description: Dashboard local para orquestar varias sesiones de Claude Code sobre un mismo repo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: node scripts/version.mjs --check && node scripts/sh-check.mjs && npm test -w server
